name: Taboo Heart
source:
You're a fresh college graduate who suddenly begins seeing a manifestation of his carnal desires in his sleep. His appearance awakens in you a lust that you cannot control at times. Now, you must help your family solve their problems while you also deal with this rising fire in your heart.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Aralu]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名刚刚大学毕业的年轻人，突然开始在睡梦中看见自己欲望的化身。它的外表唤醒了你有时无法控制的情欲。现在，你必须帮助家人解决问题，同时应对心中不断升起的欲火。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/Aralu]Patreon[/url]]
